name: hou_mcp_spatial_metadata
description: Extract or build SpatialMetadata for an asset: bounding box (x/y/z), footprint area, placement radius, world scale, unit system, placement type, anchor_capable, walkable_obstacle. No file I/O — uses metadata fields and category/placement-type dimension tables.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.assembly.bounding_box_extractor import get_bbox_extractor
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Spatial_Metadata(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_spatial_metadata"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("asset_json",     "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("world_scale",    "float",  widget_type="float", default=1.0)
        self.add_input("placement_type", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("spatial_metadata_json", "string")
        self.add_output("bbox_x",             "float")
        self.add_output("bbox_y",             "float")
        self.add_output("bbox_z",             "float")
        self.add_output("placement_radius",   "float")
        self.add_output("footprint_area",     "float")
        self.add_output("placement_type_out", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        asset_json    = str(inputs.get("asset_json", "{}") or "{}")
        world_scale   = float(inputs.get("world_scale") or 1.0)
        placement_type_override = str(inputs.get("placement_type") or "")

        try:
            asset = json.loads(asset_json) if asset_json.strip() else {}
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Failed to parse asset_json: {exc}")
            return {"spatial_metadata_json": "{}", "bbox_x": 1.0, "bbox_y": 1.0, "bbox_z": 1.0, "placement_radius": 0.5, "footprint_area": 1.0, "placement_type_out": "unknown", "exec_out": True}

        if placement_type_override:
            asset["placement_type"] = placement_type_override

        try:
            meta = get_bbox_extractor().build_spatial_metadata(asset, world_scale=world_scale)
            self.log_info(f"SpatialMetadata: {meta.asset_id} bbox={meta.bbox_x:.2f}x{meta.bbox_y:.2f}x{meta.bbox_z:.2f} type={meta.placement_type}")
            return {
                "spatial_metadata_json": json.dumps(meta.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "bbox_x":             meta.bbox_x,
                "bbox_y":             meta.bbox_y,
                "bbox_z":             meta.bbox_z,
                "placement_radius":   meta.placement_radius,
                "footprint_area":     meta.footprint_area,
                "placement_type_out": meta.placement_type,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Spatial metadata extraction failed: {exc}")
            return {"spatial_metadata_json": "{}", "bbox_x": 1.0, "bbox_y": 1.0, "bbox_z": 1.0, "placement_radius": 0.5, "footprint_area": 1.0, "placement_type_out": "unknown", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Spatial_Metadata
